items.title: Collapsible Action Pill
items.subtitle: Liquid Glass nav actions fold into one More button that keeps titles centered, and fan out with a tap.

items.title: Tab Bar Hide Styles
items.subtitle: Choose Left, Right, Fade, Down or Off for Hide Bars on Scroll, and bring back Apollo's classic scroll behavior.

items.title: Per-Account Favorites
items.subtitle: Keep a separate set of subreddit favorites for each account. They switch with the account.

items.title: Inbox Swipes
items.subtitle: Swipe back inside a chat to reach the chat list, one level per swipe, with pages that follow your finger.

items.title: Pinned Previews
items.subtitle: Inline Media, Subreddit Sections and Rich Link Previews keep their live preview on screen while you scroll.

items.title: Fixes
items.subtitle: No more freezes between subreddits, the top fade survives tab switches, and swipe-back tracks the nav bar.
